title: Tiger Road MD: day one
summary: Starting a Mega Drive port of Capcom's Tiger Road by running the arcade's own 68000 code on the console.
cover_alt: Tiger Road on the Mega Drive: the hero swings an axe in a pink-walled hall beside a giant stone statue wrapped in snakes, while soldiers attack.

title: Tiger Road NG: day one
summary: A second Tiger Road port, this time to the Neo Geo: the same arcade code, with backgrounds rebuilt from sprites and the music adapted to a different sound chip.
cover_alt: Tiger Road on the Neo Geo: the PRESS START screen, with the hero and an ogre-like enemy in a ruined stone room.
